name: Appraisal Letter Edge - Check for team invalid employee ID
goal: Verify the bot correctly handles a manager checking for a team member's appraisal letter but providing an invalid Ecode.

phases.description: User requests appraisal letter and selects 'Check for team'.
phases.completionCriteria: The bot asks for the Ecode of the employee.
The bot indicates the Ecode is invalid or not found and prompts again or ends the flow.
